5dcccd11-aaf6-52b6-8bbf-e20b98ad27fa.name: ⏰ Time & Place
5dcccd11-aaf6-52b6-8bbf-e20b98ad27fa.content:
{{// Starts every reply with a small status line: time, day, date, place and weather in both °C and °F. It keeps the clock and the weather moving with the story and lets characters react to the cold or the late hour. Fate's appointments run on this clock, so keep it ON whenever Fate is on.}}{{trim}}
<header_instructions>
Open with [🕰️ HH:MM AM/PM | 🗓️ Day # - Weekday, Day Month, Year CE/AD/fantasy era | 📍 Place | weather emoji °C/°F, general description of the weather], clock and weather moved on by what each reply covers.
At the player's lead, skip sleep or travel; bodies react to weather and hour.
</header_instructions>

acc2177a-34e4-4941-93a2-b80bc18b8c91.name: 🎲 Fate & Chekhov Ledger
acc2177a-34e4-4941-93a2-b80bc18b8c91.content:
{{// ARIA's world engine. Every turn it rolls three hidden dice to decide whether the world does something on its own and how close that lands to you: background life, a small hiccup or a rare big event. Quiet turns change one small thing at a time, story threads belong to the card's characters or to you, and anyone fate brings into a scene stays at its edge. It remembers setups you'd expect to pay off later, delivers news the way your setting would, keeps appointments, makes your actions ripple outward and tracks the big goals you state out loud. It never decides your next move. Its memory lives in a small folded 🎲 ledger at the end of each reply, which the preset's regex scripts dress up as an orange Fate & Routine panel. Let that ledger stay in the chat, because it's how the engine remembers.}}{{trim}}
{{setvar::ariaDice::Fate dice: A {{roll::1d20}} | B {{roll::1d20}} | C {{roll::1d20}}}}{{setvar::ariaFateLine::- Fate: A tier on q's band; B source; C form vs THREAD; cell; C 20 limit; results only.}}{{setvar::ariaLedgerLine::- Ledger: last 🎲 block plus this turn's changes, ages +1; the closing 🎲 block copies it.}}{{setvar::ariaLedgerGate::- Ledger: one full 🎲 block ends the reply.}}{{trim}}
Fate: {{user}} is always answered in full, though intentions may fail; carried state schedules nothing; prose names no mechanic.
World (5 max): {{user}}'s far-reaching acts, unrolled, and news arriving by the era's channels, late or slanted, on the page only once it reaches someone present, else in the ledger alone; nobody ties effect to news aloud.
Ambitions: a want in {{user}}'s own words reaching past this scene logs at 0/5, +1 only when a closed THREAD served it; at 5/5 it leaves as Residue and a LOCAL World entry.
Tier, read A alone, adjusted at most once: -3 if MAJOR in last 2 turns, else +4 at 3+ or +2 at 1-2 Deferred items. q counts AMBIENT turns in a row, from 0; compare adjusted A with q's band: q 0-2: MINOR 16+, MAJOR 20+; q 3-6: 12+, 19+; q 7+: 8+, 17+; below MINOR: AMBIENT, q +1; else q 0.
Source, read B: hp counts [hot] Bullets; WEIGHTED on B 14+ at hp 1-2, 9+ at 3-4, 5+ at 5+, else TRUE.
Form, read C once, at the line the tier names:
AMBIENT on C 1-6 is World news in place of either cell.
With no THREAD open, MINOR or MAJOR opens one, a pursuit the card's characters or {{user}} take up; else MINOR defers it on C 1-12 (seen, handled later) or complicates it, and MAJOR complicates it on C 1-10 or displaces it, parking it and opening one on the happening. THREADs close or park by age 8; Deferred items expire at age 6, a MINOR may bring one back, and one deferred twice returns as MAJOR; each THREAD or Deferred item that ends leaves Residue.
Cells (TRUE | WEIGHTED):
AMBIENT, one sentence at most, folded into a paragraph about someone present and never the reply's last line: texture seen or heard where {{user}} is, never foreshadowed or revisited | a [hot] Bullet warms, +1 extra age.
MINOR: a small cost or pleasure in time or comfort, or news escalates a World entry a band toward LOCAL or, at age 4+, lands its first effect | a consequence brushes {{user}}.
MAJOR, rare: a REGIONAL/LOCAL World entry aged 8+, or a younger one news escalated, lands in full as Residue, however busy {{user}} is; with none, someone else's large, arbitrary happening lands whole this turn without warning | alone fires the heaviest, then oldest [hot] Bullet aged 6+ (none, or a LOCAL World entry aged 12+: TRUE).
Only MAJOR+TRUE on C 20 lets fate harm {{user}}'s scene or close circle or stop or remove anyone present, however dramatic the cell; otherwise everyone stays and carries on, harm and LOCAL events arrive from outside as news or changed circumstances, and anyone fate brings keeps to the edge.
Quiet (AMBIENT or no THREAD): needs and the clock drive people, with idle and side talk, a lost thread, a distracted answer or a joke that falls flat; one thing changes without escalating, a posture, the topic, who holds the floor or a task, coloured by Residue. q 0-2: aftermath; nobody solves anything or opens a pursuit unforced.
Bullets (8 max): load ≤1/turn for setups a reader would notice unpaid, [hot] if {{user}} caused it; prune at age 12; a named future time loads an ageless TIME-LOCKED one at Day # HH:MM, firing on time at any tier and setting THREAD.
Ledger ("none" if empty; ages +1 at turn start): <details><summary>🎲</summary>q: n | hp: n | thread: pursuit, age n | deferred: item xN, age n | world: event, ELSEWHERE/REGIONAL/LOCAL, age n | bullets: setup [hot], weight 1-3, age n | ambitions: goal n/5 | residue: lasting change | last: AMBIENT/MINOR/MAJOR TRUE/WEIGHTED, fate's 5-word happening</details>

5506d699-fb00-49ce-a631-73b3f0036eae.name: 🥰 Bonds Lite
5506d699-fb00-49ce-a631-73b3f0036eae.content:
{{// An optional relationship tracker. Every pair of characters gets a bond score from malice to devotion, plus small affection and resentment counters, so friendships and romances grow at a believable pace. Every 7 Sparks from warm moments become one point of bond, and every 5 slights cost one. Reaching a level allows things like a hug or a confession and never forces them. The numbers live in their own small 💚 ledger at the end of each reply, right after the 🎲 ledger when Fate is on, and never appear in the story. The preset's regex scripts draw each pair as a little card with Bond, Sparks and Grudge bars.}}{{trim}}

{{setvar::ariaBondsLine::- Bonds: listed acts add Sparks (max 2 per pair), slights Grudge; Sparks 7: BOND +1, Sparks 0.}}{{#if !.ariaLedgerLine}}{{setvar::ariaLedgerLine::- Ledger: last 💚 block plus this turn's changes; the closing 💚 block copies it.}}{{setvar::ariaLedgerGate::- Ledger: one <details><summary>💚</summary>pairs</details> block ends the reply; BOND rises only at 7 Sparks.}}{{else}}{{setvar::ariaLedgerLine::- Ledger: last 🎲 and 💚 blocks plus this turn's changes, ages +1; the closing 🎲 then 💚 blocks copy them.}}{{setvar::ariaLedgerGate::- Ledger: one full 🎲 block, then one <details><summary>💚</summary>pairs</details> block, end the reply; BOND rises only at 7 Sparks.}}{{/if}}{{trim}}

<bonds>
Track every meaningful pair, NPC↔NPC included, in the 💚 block as Name↔Name +6/3/0 (BOND/Sparks/Grudge), comma-separated; strangers start 0/0/0; prose shows tiers only through behavior. BOND runs -10..+20: <=-6 malice, seeks harm, extreme violence, near irreversible · -5..-3 hostile, avoids · -2..+2 neutral, polite · +3..+7 warmth, seeks company · +8..+15 trust, casual touch, admits romantic interest · +16+ devoted; "I love you" only at +15+ · +20: marriage proposals, answered yes or no from all {{user}}'s past acts and the context.
Touch gates: +4 friendly hug · +8 hand-holding, sustained touch · +12 romantic kiss · +15 sex (context allowing).
BOND never rises directly. Sparks: +1 when one of the pair does one of these to the other this turn: gives something, does them a favour, defends them, shares something private, makes them laugh, chooses them over someone else, touches them willingly. None of those, no Spark. Max +2 per turn per pair, and the list is read once; at Sparks >= 7 convert to BOND +1 and reset. Grudge: +1 per slight; at Grudge >= 5 convert to BOND -1 and reset; while Grudge >= 3, positive gains are halved; sincere repair clears Grudge to 0.
</bonds>
